title: Anguilliform
summary: ANGUIL'LIFORM, adjective [Latin anguilla, an eel, and forma, shape.] In the form of an eel, or of a serpent; resembling an eel or serpent.

inlines.v: ANGUIL'LIFORM, adjective [Latin anguilla, an eel, and forma, shape.] In the form of an eel, or of a serpent; resembling an eel or serpent.
